narrative:
Henry County has 18,908 registered voters, with 16.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 41.7%, a modest Democratic lean of 4.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
